newsitem.title: UK: European bonds push higher on German gold news.
newsitem.headline: European bonds push higher on German gold news.

text.p: European bond futures shot higher in afternoon dealings amid reports the German government and the Bundesbank looked close to patching up their dispute over revaluating the Bundesbank's gold and currency reserves.
A source close to the ruling coaltion said Chancellor Helmut Kohl's coalition backed down on the contraversial plan after parlaimentary deputies from Kohl's party sharply criticised the plan.
Earlier, Finance Minister Theo Waigel and Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said they were on their way to a deal on a gold plan.
"The action is a bit peculiar," John McNeill, bond strategist at I.D.E.A. in London, said. "It does look concilliatory but we don't know what the meat and bones of it are."
"The futures contracts are technically looking quite good at the moment but the economic situation still poses some questions," he added.
"Short-term you've got to run with the price action but there are still some significant concerns," he said.
